legend: A team of furry rescue rangers was sitting idle in their hollow tree when suddenly they received a signal of distress. In a few moments they were ready, and the dirigible of the rescue chipmunks hit the road.
We assume that the action takes place on a Cartesian plane. The headquarters of the rescuers is located at point (x1, y1), and the distress signal came from the point (x2, y2).

Due to Gadget's engineering talent, the rescuers' dirigible can instantly change its current velocity and direction of movement at any moment and as many times as needed. The only limitation is: the speed of the aircraft relative to the air can not exceed ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/05a28aed63c92fafe8f32513b33646154faf8683.png) meters per second.

Of course, Gadget is a true rescuer and wants to reach the destination as soon as possible. The matter is complicated by the fact that the wind is blowing in the air and it affects the movement of the dirigible. According to the weather forecast, the wind will be defined by the vector (vx, vy) for the nearest t seconds, and then will change to (wx, wy). These vectors give both the direction and velocity of the wind. Formally, if a dirigible is located at the point (x, y), while its own velocity relative to the air is equal to zero and the wind (ux, uy) is blowing, then after ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9148a5f77a39b4083611f2ac760c9479d17582c.png) seconds the new position of the dirigible will be ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f42cccc4419e311f702830ad221b81f335011df6.png).

Gadget is busy piloting the aircraft, so she asked Chip to calculate how long will it take them to reach the destination if they fly optimally. He coped with the task easily, but Dale is convinced that Chip has given the random value, aiming only not to lose the face in front of Gadget. Dale has asked you to find the right answer.
It is guaranteed that the speed of the wind at any moment of time is strictly less than the maximum possible speed of the airship relative to the air.
input: The first line of the input contains four integers x1, y1, x2, y2 (|x1|,  |y1|,  |x2|,  |y2| ≤ 10 000) — the coordinates of the rescuers' headquarters and the point, where signal of the distress came from, respectively.

The second line contains two integers ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/05a28aed63c92fafe8f32513b33646154faf8683.png) and t (0 < v, t ≤ 1000), which are denoting the maximum speed of the chipmunk dirigible relative to the air and the moment of time when the wind changes according to the weather forecast, respectively.

Next follow one per line two pairs of integer (vx, vy) and (wx, wy), describing the wind for the first t seconds and the wind that will blow at all the remaining time, respectively. It is guaranteed that ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4ddbd171d9061576ebb160327d6360a2129809aa.png) and ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e2970f5978fa0d3691dc2f7ae02f0c21a76e2d47.png).
output: Print a single real value — the minimum time the rescuers need to get to point (x2, y2). You answer will be considered correct if its absolute or relative error does not exceed 10 - 6.

Namely: let's assume that your answer is a, and the answer of the jury is b. The checker program will consider your answer correct, if ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png).

output.ai: 输出一个实数——救援人员到达点 (x2, y2) 所需的最短时间。如果你的答案的绝对误差或相对误差不超过 10^{-6}，则你的答案将被视为正确。
即：假设你的答案为 a，裁判的答案为 b。如果 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c97ba2000ebfad962bff7ffd8d043594f5ae1086.png)，检查程序将认为你的答案正确。

legend.ai: 一队毛茸茸的救援游骑兵正百无聊赖地坐在它们的空心树里，突然收到了一条求救信号。没过多久，它们就准备好了，救援花栗鼠们的飞艇出发了。
我们假设行动发生在直角坐标平面上。救援人员的总部位于点 (x1, y1)，而求救信号来自点 (x2, y2)。
由于 Gadget 的工程天赋，救援人员的飞艇可以在任意时刻、根据需要任意多次地瞬间改变当前速度和运动方向。唯一的限制是：飞行器相对于空气的速度不能超过 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/05a28aed63c92fafe8f32513b33646154faf8683.png) 米每秒。

当然，Gadget 是一名真正的救援者，她希望尽快抵达目的地。但空中吹着风，会影响飞艇的运动，使事情变得复杂。根据天气预报，接下来最近的 t 秒内，风由向量 (vx, vy) 表示，之后将变为 (wx, wy)。这些向量同时表示风的方向和速度。形式化地说，如果飞艇位于点 (x, y)，其相对于空气的自身速度为零，且正在刮着风 (ux, uy)，那么经过 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/c9148a5f77a39b4083611f2ac760c9479d17582c.png) 秒后，飞艇的新位置将为 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/f42cccc4419e311f702830ad221b81f335011df6.png)。
Gadget 正忙于驾驶飞行器，因此她让 Chip 计算如果采取最优飞行方式，他们需要多长时间才能抵达目的地。他轻松地完成了任务，但 Dale 认为 Chip 给出的只是一个随机值，只是为了不在 Gadget 面前丢脸。Dale 请你求出正确答案。
保证在任意时刻，风速都严格小于飞艇相对于空气的最大可能速度。

input.ai: 输入的第一行包含四个整数 x1、y1、x2、y2（|x1|、  |y1|、|x2|、|y2| ≤ 10 000），分别表示救援人员总部的坐标，以及发出求救信号的地点坐标。
第二行包含两个整数 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/05a28aed63c92fafe8f32513b33646154faf8683.png) 和 t(0 < v、t ≤ 1000)，分别表示花栗鼠飞艇相对于空气的最大速度，以及根据天气预报风向发生变化的时刻。

接下来每行包含两对整数 (vx, vy) 和 (wx, wy)，分别描述前 t 秒内的风，以及之后剩余时间内一直刮的风。保证 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/4ddbd171d9061576ebb160327d6360a2129809aa.png) 和 ![](https://espresso.codeforces.com/e2970f5978fa0d3691dc2f7ae02f0c21a76e2d47.png)。
